claim: For any null distribution P, any alpha in (0,1), and confidence bounds satisfying Equation 6 at delta, the conditional probability of ever crossing 1/alpha is at most alpha for at least 1-delta of reference sets.

FALSIFIED: The selected P is within the stated any-distribution domain and the reference and stream are iid from P.
Equation 6 holds for the realized reference set.
The exact Equation 8 process or the released Algorithm 1 implementation crosses 1/alpha at a finite time.
The resulting inner false-rejection probability exceeds alpha and the outer good-reference probability is below 1-delta.
An independent checker reconstructs the witness without importing released implementation code.
verdict_rule.VERIFIED: Not available from finite simulation for this universally quantified theorem.
verdict_rule.BLOCKED: Use if no assumption-satisfying proof certificate or counterexample is obtained.

non_circularity: The 64-step horizon is only a container for a finite crossing witness. It was not derived from the claimed error bound and the checker reports the first crossing. One finite assumption-satisfying crossing with probability one contradicts the anytime universal bound.
